best_drive_from_back.label: P21 to P18
best_drive_from_back.why: Fernando Alonso gained 3 places from P21 in the 11th-fastest car.

best_strategy.label: +6.0 places through the stops
best_strategy.why: Fernando Alonso's 2-stop race cost 6.0 fewer places in the pit windows than the race's average stop.

fastest_stop.label: 21.0 s in the pit lane
fastest_stop.why: Quickest trip through the pit lane, lap 37 (no stationary times published).

overtake_of_race.label: on Lando Norris, lap 7
overtake_of_race.why: Liam Lawson passed Lando Norris for P8 on lap 7 despite being +0.89 s/lap slower on corrected pace.

unluckiest.label: 10.0 points lost
unluckiest.why: Stopped on lap 24, 1 lap(s) before the VSC: P1 before the stop, P3 at the flag.

smoothest.label: 0.294 s lap-time sd
smoothest.why: George Russell's corrected clean laps varied by just 0.294 s (1 sd).

team_of_weekend.label: +11.6 pts v expected
